name: LAOWA
trademark: Anhui Changgeng Optical Technology Co., Ltd. (Venus Optics / LAOWA)
notes: Commons SVG is a single path in the brand teal (#44aca6) with no transforms, text, or background; recoloured to the app's single fill colour. The stylised "LA" and "WA" are joined ligature shapes with crossbar-less A's; the O is an outer ellipse with an offset inner counter (opposite winding, also evenodd-safe). Closed the two ellipse subpaths explicitly with Z and rounded to 2 decimals. Commons source cites a Venus Optics product PDF (laowalenses.ca). No ® mark or tagline present.
